newsitem.title: CHINA: China coal mine explosion kills 27.
newsitem.headline: China coal mine explosion kills 27.

text.p: A gas explosion in a private coal mine in central China has killed 27 miners, injured six and left another five missing, officials said on Tuesday.

Rescue workers had recovered 27 bodies from the coal mine in Pingdingshan in central Henan province after the explosion on December 2, officials of the Pingdingshan Coal Management Bureau said by telephone.
A search was under way for five miners still missing, but there was little hope of finding survivors, the officials said.
The cause of the explosion was not known.
One official said safety precautions at the mine were poor. He declined to elaborate.
Coal mine accidents kill about 10,000 people in China each year, many of them in small, poorly-organised mines run by local governments or townships.
China has passed regulations in recent years to try to reassert control over the growing number of small, unregulated mines, and to reduce deadly accidents.
